NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 24th November , 2022 

S.O. 5471 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , number S.O.3977 ( E ) , dated the 23rd August 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , 
Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 
of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , 
management and operation of NH49 on the stretch of land from Km.79 / 660 to Km.192 / 700 ( Paramakudi 
Ramanathapuram - Rameswaram Section ) in the district of RAMANATHAPURAM in the state of TAMIL NADU 


Taluk : Paramakudi 

Village : Ariyanendal 


कुल 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Daily Thanthi ” and “ The 
Hindu " both dated 03rd September 2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


Type of Land 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ;

And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 24th November , 2022 

S.O. 5480 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section 
( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / six - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , 
management and operation of NH4 on the stretch of land from Km . 515 to Km . 592.705 in the district of 
BELAGAVI in the state of KARNATAKA ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Vijay Karnataka " and 
“ The Times of India ” both dated 01-10-2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by 
the Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent 
Authority has submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ;

New Delhi, the 25th November, 2022 


G.S.R. 847(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (0) of sub-section (2) of section 56 
of the Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force Act, 992 (35 of 992), and in supersession of the Indo-Tibetan 
Border Police Force, General Duty Cadre, (Group “B’ and ‘C’ Posts) Recruitment Rules, 20l2, in so far as 
it relate to the posts of Assistant Sub-Inspector(General Duty), Head Constable(General Duty) and 
Constable(General Duty) except things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the Central 
Government hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the posts of 
Assistant Sub-Inspector(General Duty), Head Constable(General Duty) and Constable(General Duty), in the 
Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force, namely :— 


l. Short title and commencement.— (a) These rules may be called the Indo-Tibetan Border Police 
Force, General Duty Cadre (Group “C’ Posts), Recruitment Rules, 2022. 


(b) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Application.- These rules shall apply to the posts specified in column (]) of the schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Number of posts, classification and level in the pay matrix.— The number of posts, their 
classification and the level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of 
the said Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age-limit and other qualifications, etc.— The method of recruitment, age- 
limit, qualifications and other matters relating thereto, shall be as specified in columns (5) to ((3) of the said 
Schedule. 


5. Disqualification.— No person,— 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said posts : 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the 
personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds 
for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


6. Medical Fitness.— Notwithstanding anything contained in these rules, only those persons who are in 
medical category SHAPE-I, as specified in Health Care System in Central Armed Police Forces, shall be 
eligible for appointment and promotion including appointment by deputation or re-employment under the 
provisions of these rules. 


7. Superannuation. — (]) Every person appointed under these rules shall retire from service in the 
afternoon of the last day of month in which he or she attains the age of sixty years or as prescribed by the 
Central Government from time-to-time : 


Provided that an officer whose date of birth is on the first day of a month shall retire from service in 
the afternoon of the last day of the preceding month on attaining the age of sixty years. 


8. Power to relax.— Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so 
to do, it may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules 
with respect of any class or category of persons. 


9. Saving.— Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
servicemen and other special categories of persons, in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time-to-time in this regard.

अधिनियम, 1968 (1968 का 46) की धारा 36 की अपेक्षानुसार, भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग-||, खंड 3,

संख्यांक सा.का.नि. 670 (अ) दिनांक 29 सितंबर, 2021 द्वारा प्रकाशित की गई थी, जिसमें उक्त अधिसूचना में ऐसे सभी 
व्यक्तियों से, जिनके इससे प्रभावित होने की संभावना थी उस तिथि से, जिसको उस राजपत्र की प्रतियां, जिसमें उक्त 
अधिसूचना प्रकाशित की गयी थी, पंद्रह दिनों की अवधि के समाप्त होने से पहले, आक्षेप या सुझावों को आमंत्रित करने के 
लिये जनसाधारण को उपलब्ध करा दी गयी थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनसाधारण को तारीख 29 सितंबर, 2021 को उपलब्ध करा दी गयी थी; 


और THT TST नियमों के संबंध में जनसाधारण से प्राप्त आक्षेपों और सुझावों पर केंद्रीय सरकार द्वारा सम्यक्‌ रूप 
से विचार किया गया है; 


अत:, अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, कीटनाशी अधिनियम, 1968 (1968 का 46) की धारा 36 द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का 
प्रयोग करते हुए कीटनाशी नियम, 1971 का और संशोधन करने के लिए निम्नलिखित नियम बनाती है, अर्थात्‌:-

1. संक्षिप्त नाम और प्रारंभ — (1) इन नियमों का संक्षिप्त नाम कीटनाशी (दूसरा संशोधन) नियम, 2022 है। 
(2) ये राजपत्र में इनके प्रकाशन की तारीख को प्रवृत्त होंगे । 
2. कीटनाशी नियम, 1971 (जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त नियम कहा गया है) के नियम 9 के उपनियम (3) में, खंड (iii) 


के पश्चात्‌ निम्नलिखित परंतुक अंतःस्थापित किया जाएगा, अर्थात्‌ :- 


“परन्तु यह कि अनुज्ञप्ति अधिकारी अपना यह समाधान करने के लिए कि उस परिसर में, जहां कीटनाशी का 
विनिर्माण किया जाना प्रस्तावित है, आवश्यक संयंत्र और मशीनरी, सुरक्षा युक्तियां और प्राथमिक सहायता तथा

का.आ. 5502 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने रेल अधिनियम , 1989 ( 1989 का 24 ) एवं रेलवे ( संशोधन ) अधिनियम ,

के राजपत्र , असाधारण भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उप - खण्ड ( ii ) तारीख 02 सितम्बर 2022 में प्रकाशित भारत सरकार के रेल 
मंत्रालय ( रेलवे बोर्ड ) की अधिसूचना का . आ . 4135 ( अ ) दिनांक 23 अगस्त 2022 द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को राजस्थान राज्य के जोधपुर जिले में विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात् डेगाना- राई का बाग 
दोहरीकरण परियोजना के निष्पादन , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए अर्जित करने के लिए अपने आशय की घोषणा 
की थी ; 


और , उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 क की उप - धारा ( 4 ) के अधीन स्थानीय दैनिक 
समाचार पत्रों " राजस्थान पत्रिका " व " दैनिक भास्कर " मे तरीख 09 सितम्बर 2022 को प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और , सक्षम प्राधिकारी को उक्त भूमि के सम्बन्ध में धारा 20 घ ( 2 ) के अन्तर्गत कोई आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई ; 
और , सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ङ की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण मे अपनी रिपोर्ट केन्द्रीय

विधि व्यवसायी के मार्फत सक्षम प्राधिकारी ( भूमि अवाप्ति ) एवम् उप खण्ड अधिकारी ( उत्तर ) जोधपुर के कार्यालय मे किसी

यह और कि , केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ङ की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह और घोषणा 
करती है कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशित होने पर इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची मे विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से 
मुक्त होकर केन्द्रीय सरकार में आत्यंतिक रूप से निहित हो जाएगी ।

Jaipur , the 15th November , 2022 

S.O. 5502 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India , in the Ministry of 
Railways ( Railway Board ) , No S.O. 4135 ( A ) dated 23rd August 2022 published in Gazette of India , 
Extraordinary , Part II , Section - 3 , Sub Section ( ii ) dated 02 September ( hereinafter referred to as the said 
notification ) , under sub section ( 1 ) of section 20A of the Railway Act , 1989 ( 24 of 1989 ) and 
Railway ( Amendment ) Act , 2008 ( 11 of 2008 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Special Railway Project , namely 
Degana - Rai ka Bagh Doubling project in District Jodhpur in the state of Rajasthan . 


And , whereas , the substance of the said notification were published in daily local newspapers 
“ Rajasthan Patrika ” and “ Dainik Bhaskar " dated 09th September , 2022 under sub - section ( 4 ) of section 20A 
of the said act ; 


And , whereas , the competent authority has not received any objections under sub section ( 2 ) of the 

section 20D of the act . 


And , whereas , in pursuance of sub section ( 1 ) of section 20E of the said act , the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ]

conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 20E of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ;

PUBLIC NOTICE 
New Delhi, the 25th November, 2022 
No. 38/205-2020 


Subject:- Fixation of new Standard Input Output Norms (SION) at E-36 for export of wheat flour (Atta), deletion of 
SION E-l0, amendment in Appendix 4J and insertion of new para 4.05 (iii) under Handbook of 
Procedures 205-20- reg. 


F. No. 0/94/80/57/AM-22/PC-4.— In exercise of the powers conferred under paragraph .03 & 2.04 of 
the Foreign Trade Policy (FTP), 20I5-2020, as amended from time to time, and as per provision of paragraph 4.3 of 
Foreign Trade Policy, the Director General of Foreign Trade hereby makes the following amendments: 


[भाग I—ars |] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 3 


l. The Standard Input Output Norms (SION) E-0 stands deleted. 


2. Anew SION in food products category is inserted as under: 


SION Export Item Quantity Import Item Quantity 


E-36 Wheat Flour (Atta) .00 Kg. Wheat .07 Kg. 


Note: For the purpose of this SION, ‘wheat flour (atta)’ implies to “whole wheat flour (atta)’ and the same is to be 
endorsed as technical characteristic while applying for the Advance Authorization. 


3. The Advance Authorization (AA) under this SION is subject to the following conditions: 


l. The Advance Authorization (AA) shall be issued only to flour millers. 
il. The AA shall be issued with pre-import condition. 
iii. The SION is valid until ‘wheat’ is prohibited for exports. Thereafter, no further AA will be issued 


under the SION. AAs already issued will continue to operate in the normal course. 


iv. The Bills of Entry against which wheat has been imported shall be confirmed by Custom Authorities 
while allowing exports. 


Vv. Procurement of wheat from Domestic Tariff Area (DTA) is not permissible in any case against the 
Advance Authorization. 


4. The following amendment is made in Appendix 4J: 


Serial No. Import Item(s) Export Obligation Period with pre-import condition from the date of 
clearance of each import consignment by Customs Authority 


4. Wheat 80 days 


5. After sub para 4.05 (i) a new sub-para 4.05 (iii) is introduced as under: 


“Wheat Flour (Atta)” is permitted to be exported under the Advance Authorization Scheme, subject to 
pre-import condition of wheat under the notified SION only. No domestic/ indigenous sourcing of wheat is 
permitted and the invalidation letter/ARO facility is not available. Third party exports are also not allowed in 
this case. Import and Export would be permitted only through EDI enabled ports. The Export Obligation 
period (EOP) of Advance Authorization for wheat shall be 80 days from the date of clearance of each 
import consignment and no extension in EOP shall be allowed. Such import shall be subject to actual user 
condition and no transfer of imported wheat for any purpose, including job work, shall be permitted. In case 
of non-fulfilment of EO/ non-achievement of stipulated value addition, a penalty equal to five times of the 
CIF value of the imported material, corresponding to the shortfall in EO, shall be imposed in addition to the 
payment of applicable duty and interest. Provisions of Paragraph 4.49 of Handbook of Procedures shall not 
be applicable in this case. 


Effect of this Public Notice: 


The SION-EI0 stands deleted. The export of wheat flour (atta) is allowed under Advance Authorization 
Scheme. Accordingly, a new SION has been notified and import of “Wheat’ is placed under Appendix 4J with 
pre-import condition. Domestic procurement is not allowed in case of such Advance Authorization.
